ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would happen to goats if the green plants decreased?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the picture is a forest food web, with a green plant labeled “Green Plant / Producer” in the lower left corner, and a goat labeled “Goat” in the upper left. In the picture there is an arrow from the direction of the green plant pointing to the goat, indicating that the goat depends on or eats the green plant. Then reason: the question asks what will happen to the goat if the green plants decrease. Because green plants are the goat’s food source, a decrease in the food source will make the consumers that depend on it obtain less food, so the number of goats will also decrease.
